title: store::count_messages is pub but only used in tests — should be cfg(test)
description: store.rs: pub async fn count_messages has a comment '(used in tests)' but is unconditionally pub. A contributor browsing the store API surface would include it in a public API audit. It will never be appropriate to call this in production code. Fix: #[cfg(test)] and move it into the test module, or add a #[doc(hidden)] if you need it from integration test crates.
